question: The Pittsburgh Pirates have been playing since 1882, nearly 22,000 games. After all of that, how many games over .500 is their all-time record?
answer_detail: Through the 2026 season they're 10,992-10,990. They actually slipped under .500 in July 2025 for the first time since 1903, then an 82-80 season this year pulled them back over.
